title: Evaluation suite: fixtures, task evals with and without skills, trigger sets, benchmark
description: skill-creator benchmark over scaffolded fixture repos (bare remote, branches in every containment state, junk and build files, fake HOME with ~/.claude debris) with objective graders that inspect the resulting state rather than trusting the agent's report; per-skill trigger sets with near-miss negatives.

acceptanceCriteria.text: evals/evals.json lists every task eval with assertions
objective graders check resulting repo and filesystem state
benchmark.json and benchmark.md exist for at least one iteration comparing with-skill and without-skill
each skill has a trigger set with at least 5 should-fire and 3 near-miss queries
